name: Scoped entailment controls v2: original18 plus10 frozen scope/modal cases
provenance: Visible session-assisted reference labels fixed before any v3 native dispatch. Original18 documents/claims/labels/gates unchanged. Ten additional modal, finite-excerpt and global-absence cases distinguish source entailment from unsupported interfaces. This is development calibration, not external or blind truth.

documents.title: Approval contract
documents.text: Approval is bound to the exact tool name and arguments. Changing the payload invalidates the decision. Saving approval does not execute the operation.

documents.title: Uncertain write recovery
documents.text: Interrupted non-idempotent writes require reconciliation. Confirm the original operation's external outcome before deciding how to continue. Do not silently repeat the write.

documents.title: Budget admission
documents.text: Persist the worst allowed model spending reservation before dispatch. Keep uncertain reservations when a request may have incurred a charge. Generation budgets exclude embedding and tool-service charges.

documents.title: Delivery scope
documents.text: This excerpt states that no guarantee of complete delivery is provided. It describes commit of the local record in one transaction.

documents.title: Acknowledgement timing
documents.text: Record acknowledgement is persisted before reply. This excerpt describes this acknowledgement timing only.
